sections.appearance: Sena has neck length white hair and fitting bangs. She has yellow eyes and 2 brown horns. Halo ==== Sena's halo is light gray, resembling the shape of a cut in half circumference, with spikes on both top and bottom sides and arrow-like figures on the right and left. Located within is another cut in half circumference, this time cut horizontally with four diagonal spikes aiming at the center. Uniform ==== Sena wears a short-sleeved war nurse uniform that consists of a navy blue knee-length dress, a waist-length white apron, a nurse cap, black boots, and a little ammo box on her waist. She also has some accessories, such as black gloves, a white band with a yellow heart with some wings and a plus sign in its center on her left arm, and a brown badge above her left chest. Firearm ==== thumb|Emergency Rush Kit|150px She uses a purple M79 Grenade Launcher with the barrel and wooden stock sawed off. A white Gehenna logo is imprinted on the barrel. thumb|Emergency Vehicle No. 11|150px For her EX skill she rides on a Horch 108 Kfz. 31 heavy off-road car.

sections.personality: Sena is typically calm and expressionless, and is often highly-focused on her work. Due to the extensive casual violence that occurs within Gehenna's district, she has a habit of shooting downed students to determine if they have been incapacitated or are merely playing opossum. She is known for having a shocking sense of morbidity, often referring to those she treats as being deceased. It is unknown where this particular trait comes from.
